investigations.name: ACME
investigations.objective: Studies gaseous non-premixed flames for terrestrial combustion efficiency, pollutant reduction and materials flammability research.
investigations.summary: Studies gaseous non-premixed flames for terrestrial combustion efficiency, pollutant reduction and materials flammability research.
limitations: ACME is a program grouping distinct experiments rather than one comparable run.
The historical overview describes five studies; later program reviews include six.
Only BRE has spacecraft fire prevention as its primary objective in this overview.

investigations.name: BRE
investigations.objective: Uses gaseous flames above a porous burner to emulate solid and liquid fuel burning and study flammability and extinction.
investigations.summary: Uses gaseous flames above a porous burner to emulate solid and liquid fuel burning and study flammability and extinction.
limitations: Gaseous analog experiment; does not directly test each represented solid material.
Relevance to low or partial gravity is a research objective, not proof of partial-gravity measurements.
Run conditions and measurements have not been imported.

investigations.summary: Examines electric-field control of ion transport, flame stability, soot and heat transfer in gas-fueled flames.
limitations: NASA identifies terrestrial combustion as the intended application.
Possible space applications are not demonstrated spacecraft suppression capability.
No raw electric-field or flame measurements have been imported.

incidents.title: Apollo 1 ground-test cabin fire
incidents.summary: A fatal flash fire occurred during a closed-hatch ground test in an oxygen atmosphere.
lessons: Control combustible material loading and ignition hazards.
incidents.relationship: Thematic material-flammability relevance; no claim of direct causal lineage.

incidents.title: Apollo 13 oxygen-tank explosion
incidents.summary: An oxygen-tank failure damaged the Service Module and forced cancellation of the lunar landing. This was not an ordinary cabin fire.
lessons: Review engineering and manufacturing processes for oxygen systems.
incidents.relationship: System-design lesson; combustion experiment relevance requires separate evidence.

incidents.title: Mir oxygen-generator fire
incidents.summary: A solid-fuel oxygen-generator canister ignited in Kvant-1, producing dense smoke and obstructing an evacuation path.
lessons: Maintain accessible respiratory protection and extinguishers.
Train coordinated emergency response and post-fire atmosphere recovery.
incidents.relationship: Thematic smoke-detection and response relevance; experiments are not claimed to have prevented this event.

earth_applications.title: Firefighter breathing equipment
earth_applications.summary: NASA's 1976 account describes a Johnson Space Center and Scott Aviation collaboration on lighter composite firefighter breathing tanks and improved masks.
limitations: Historical account; specifications and commercial availability are not current product recommendations.

earth_applications.title: Early fire particle detection
earth_applications.summary: A 1978 Spinoff account describes a detector that distinguishes combustion particles from dust to reduce false alarms.
limitations: Historical reported performance; no present-day independent certification or product availability verified.

earth_applications.title: Protective clothing: Project FIRES
earth_applications.summary: NASA and the U.S. Fire Administration applied Apollo-related protective materials and design ideas to firefighter equipment evaluations.
limitations: Historical field evaluation; current commercial adoption has not been verified.

earth_applications.title: Suppression research and terrestrial combustion models
earth_applications.summary: FLEX research examines inert-gas effects on droplet flammability and informs combustion-model development.
limitations: Research relevance; no deployable terrestrial suppression product is established by this source.
